articles.title: “I’m getting to play with these kids": Lewis Hamilton opens up about Kim Kardashian’s kids as speculation about a baby grows
articles.summary: Lewis Hamilton has offered a rare glimpse into his relationship with Kim Kardashian’s children, revealing a thoughtful gesture that has brought him closer
articles.body: Lewis Hamilton has offered a rare glimpse into his relationship with Kim Kardashian’s children, revealing a thoughtful gesture that has brought him closer to her family. The Formula 1 champion shared that he bought a dog named Halo for Kim’s four children, North, Saint, Chicago and Psalm. His warm comments came as speculation continues about whether the couple could welcome a child together. While neither has confirmed plans to expand their family, Hamilton’s remarks have drawn fresh attention to the bond he is building with the children.Lewis Hamilton reveals his bond with Kim Kardashian’s childrenHamilton opened up about family life while speaking to reporters during an event at the United States Grand Prix in Texas. Asked what brings him happiness away from racing, the seven-time world champion spoke affectionately about his niece and nephew before mentioning Kim’s children.“My niece and nephew always bring me a lot of happiness [and so do] my girlfriend’s kids. I love spending time with them. She’s got four.”He then revealed that he had surprised the children with a pet, giving fans a glimpse of a more personal side of his relationship with the reality star.“I’m getting to play with these kids, and I got them a dog this year. So, little Halo is a new member of that family,” he said.Halo, a golden retriever puppy, has already appeared on Kim’s social media. The gift suggests Hamilton has found a place in the family’s everyday life, although the couple has kept most details of their relationship private.Kim shares four children with her former husband, Kanye West. North, Saint, Chicago and Psalm have occasionally appeared in social media posts featuring Hamilton. The pair knew each other for years before their romance became public, which may have helped make their time together feel more familiar.Kim Kardashian and Lewis Hamilton face renewed baby speculationHamilton’s comments have also revived interest in reports that the couple may want a child together. An August report from Us Weekly, citing an unnamed source, claimed Kim had considered having more children with the British racing driver.“They are really in love. Kim may want to have more kids with Lewis,” the source said. “They just get each other, they get each other’s quirks. She is really happy with him.”The source also described the couple as well matched, saying their shared drive and understanding had helped their relationship.However, the reports remain unconfirmed. Neither Kim nor Hamilton has publicly announced plans to have a baby together, and his latest comments focused on the happiness he finds in spending time with the children she already has.For now, the clearest takeaway is Hamilton’s growing connection with Kim’s family. Whether that bond eventually leads to a bigger family remains an open question, not a confirmed plan.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: Three-time Asian Para Games gold medallist Neeraj Yadav dies by suicide
articles.summary: NEW DELHI: Indian para-athletics was left in shock after three-time Asian Para Games gold medallist Neeraj Yadav allegedly died by suicide at a flat on
articles.body: NEW DELHI: Indian para-athletics was left in shock after three-time Asian Para Games gold medallist Neeraj Yadav allegedly died by suicide at a flat on Tuesday night, sources told TOI. The 42-year-old, who competed in the F55 category, suspected to have consumed poison. A postmortem examination was underway at Delhi’s GTB Hospital on Wednesday at the time of filing the report.Who was Neeraj Yadav? - All you need to knowParalympic champion Sumit Antil and fellow para-athlete Vipin Kasana were present at the hospital, sources said. The circumstances surrounding Yadav’s death are yet to be established.India’s chief para-athletics coach S Satyanarayana confirmed the development to TOI, saying he had learnt that Yadav had died by suicide.“Yes, Neeraj has died by suicide. That is what I have also come to know. I have been told that he consumed poison at his flat last night. This is extremely unfortunate and tragic,” Satyanarayana said.The coach suggested that Yadav may have been under emotional distress after missing the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Para Games because of his doping suspension. However, the circumstances that led to his death remain unconfirmed.“He would have been looking forward to competing at these Games. Medals at the Asian Para Games can bring substantial government cash awards and opportunities for stable employment. But his suspension had not ended, and he could not compete. It is possible that this affected him deeply, but we cannot say for certain what he was going through,” Satyanarayana added.Yadav, who hails from Uttar Pradesh, was among India’s accomplished para-athletes. Diagnosed with post-polio residual paralysis at the age of seven, he nevertheless pursued his sporting ambitions. He played wheelchair tennis between 2005 and 2012 before switching to para-athletics.His breakthrough came at the 2015 Delhi State Athletics Meet, where he won gold medals in the shot put, javelin and discus events.Yadav announced himself on the international stage at the 2018 Asian Para Games in Jakarta, winning gold in the men’s F55 javelin throw with an Asian-record effort of 29.84 metres.He subsequently clinched two gold medals at the Hangzhou Asian Para Games in 2023, winning the javelin and discus events to take his career tally to three Asian Para Games titles.However, his career was clouded by an anti-doping case. The National Anti-Doping Agency provisionally suspended him after an out-of-competition sample collected in Bengaluru in October 2023 tested positive for stanozolol, an anabolic steroid. He later sought DNA testing of his sample through the anti-doping disciplinary process.His death marks a tragic turn in the life of an athlete who overcame significant physical challenges to reach the top of Asian para-athletics.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Mikel Arteta reveals Arsenal’s missing trio are injury doubts for Liverpool clash
articles.summary: Declan Rice, Riccardo Calafiori and Noni Madueke all missed out on the Fleetwood upset due to fitness problems
articles.body:
Mikel Arteta has revealed a triple injury blow for Arsenal in light of their shock Carabao Cup exit to League Two side Fleetwood Town .

The Gunners were beaten on penalties at Fleetwood on Tuesday night after being held to a 1-1 draw in 90 minutes, with Arteta's decision to rotate heavily backfiring.

Injuries forced his hand on some selection decisions, however, with the Spaniard revealing after the match that Declan Rice , Riccardo Calafiori and Noni Madueke all missed out due to fitness problems.

"Riccardo was out, Noni was out with an ankle and Declan Rice was finished with a problem the other day. That's why I had to substitute him [against Everton ]," Arteta said.

The trio could now be doubts for the trip to Liverpool on Sunday, where Arsenal will need to bounce back from cup humiliation.

Their absence compounds Arsenal's growing injury woes this season, with a crisis beginning to develop going forward.

Talismanic winger Bukayo Saka could be out until Christmas after being forced off against Bayern Munich with a thigh injury, joining summer recruit Christos Tzolis on the treatment table.

Madueke's return to form, scoring a late winner at Nottingham Forest earlier this month, was welcomed as Arteta began to operate him on both flanks as a result of injuries, but his own setback will now give the Gunners boss an almighty selection headache.

This will be exacerbated by the suspension of teenager Max Dowman , who will miss the next three games after being sent off for kicking out at a Fleetwood player on a miserable night in the north west.

"I'm sad, I think we are all sad," Arteta said after the match. "We have a massive responsibility to carry this badge in the best possible way.

"It had nothing to do with effort or application or determination to win it, but we lack other things to, to create a much bigger margin than today, with what we produce, they really should have been shown in the scoreline."
